executive_summary: The capability-evolver skill is a self-evolution engine for AI agents, analyzing runtime history and writing improvements. It communicates with EvoMap Hub via a local Proxy and has LOW risks in UNSAFE FILE OPERATIONS, PROMPT INJECTION SUSCEPTIBILITY, and MEMORY POISONING & PERSISTENCE ATTACKS categories.
skill_purpose_analysis: The skill's design involves self-improvement and communication with external systems, introducing inherent risks.
dangerous_patterns: Sends user-supplied data to external systems
remediation_priority: Limit file writes to specific, non-user-supplied paths, sanitize user-supplied data, and validate memory content before writing.

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure File Operations
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill writes to user-supplied paths, potentially allowing unauthorized access or path traversal attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker provides a symlink or manipulates the path to overwrite sensitive files.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Limit file writes to specific, non-user-supplied paths and validate paths before writing.

vulnerabilities.title: Prompt Injection Susceptibility
vulnerabilities.affected_content: Sends messages to the Proxy and EvoMap Hub
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill sends user-supplied data to external systems, potentially allowing prompt injection attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker injects malicious instructions into the Proxy or EvoMap Hub via the skill's messages.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Sanitize user-supplied data before sending it to external systems.

vulnerabilities.title: Memory Poisoning and Persistence Attacks
vulnerabilities.explanation: The skill writes to memory, potentially allowing memory poisoning and persistence attacks.
vulnerabilities.attack_scenario: An attacker manipulates the memory content, influencing future agent turns.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Validate memory content before writing and limit memory write access.
